questions.q: What is the first step in the role design checklist used for Castellan Robotics' finance team?
options: Build custom duty roles for every person immediately
List the real people and what they are actually responsible for, not job titles alone
Disable segregation of duties monitoring
Assign every person the same job role for consistency
questions.explain: The exercise starts by mapping real responsibilities to people, which then drives which seeded roles are appropriate — not the reverse.

questions.q: Why were no custom roles needed for Priya, Marcus, Dana, or Tom?
options: Custom roles are never allowed in Oracle Fusion
Oracle does not support job roles for small companies
Custom roles only apply to Human Capital Management
Every one of their requirements matched what an existing seeded job role already provides
questions.explain: Following the Lesson 11 principle, seeded roles were used because each person's needs matched an existing seeded job role's design — custom roles are reserved for genuine gaps.

questions.q: Marcus Webb's General Accountant role includes basic journal posting, but the design requires that he can't approve his own entries. How is that requirement enforced?
options: By an approval workflow rule layered on top of his role-based access
By removing his posting duty role entirely, leaving him unable to post anything
It cannot be enforced in Oracle Fusion at all
By giving him a completely different job role with no posting ability
questions.explain: Rather than stripping the posting duty role, the design uses an approval workflow rule to ensure his own entries require someone else's approval — layering workflow controls on top of role-based access.

questions.q: What is the correct point in the process to check a proposed role design for segregation-of-duties conflicts?
options: After all users have been provisioned and are already working in the system
SoD conflicts don't need to be checked if seeded roles are used
Before anyone is provisioned, as part of the design process itself
Only during the annual external audit
questions.explain: The checklist calls for checking the combined design for SoD conflicts before anyone is provisioned, catching problems before they become real access.

questions.q: In the Castellan Robotics example, why does Dana Ferreira's Accounts Payable Specialist role not create a segregation-of-duties conflict with payment approval?
options: Because Dana is not allowed to use Payables at all
Because payment approval is a separate duty role not included in Accounts Payable Specialist, and it stays with Priya's Accounts Payable Manager role
Because segregation of duties does not apply to Payables
Because all AP roles automatically include payment approval by default
questions.explain: Payment approval sits in a different, manager-level duty role (per Lesson 12), which Accounts Payable Specialist does not include — keeping entry and approval properly separated.
